# Copilot Instructions for Japan Travel Website

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

## Project Overview
This is an interactive Japan travel website built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The main features include:

- Comic-style interactive map of Japan as the landing page
- Clickable major cities that show detailed tourist attractions
- Rich visual content with images and relevant links
- Modern, responsive design
- Fun and engaging user experience

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components and pages
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling with custom components
- Implement responsive design for mobile and desktop
- Focus on visual appeal and user interaction
- Use modern React patterns (hooks, functional components)
- Optimize images and performance

## Component Structure
- Interactive map component for the landing page
- City detail components with attraction listings
- Reusable UI components for consistent design
- Image galleries and interactive elements

## Styling Approach
- Comic/cartoon aesthetic for the map
- Modern, clean design for city pages
- Vibrant colors that reflect Japanese culture
- Smooth animations and transitions
- Mobile-first responsive design
